data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis F9): Follow-on emission lifecycle — follow-ons are emitted in the SAME mutations manifest as the probe mutation that produced them (sub-mutations / cascade pattern). Each follow-on carries a `parent_pass_id` field linking back to the probe pass. Hard-write rule: a probe pass that produces follow-ons is one manifest with N+M mutations (N originals, M cascades) — NOT a two-pass deferred dispatch. This preserves cde1's manifest hash-stability DoD (deterministic single-manifest output per (local_state, jira_state)) while making follow-ons visible to the applier in the same dispatch cycle.
